approval_required_for: Any deviation from artifact.stage2.template_selection or any major template modification during code generation.
Any change to artifact.stage3.pipeline_plan pipeline stage structure, stream order, residual/branch topology, buffering, flow-control, or liveness assumptions.
Any change to artifact.stage4.parameter_binding tile sizes, parallelism factors, data packing, memory layout, memory schedule, or resource/bandwidth assumptions.
Any change to constraint.numeric.policy such as datatype, accumulation, rounding, saturation, approximation, or quantization behavior.
Any change to AXI/DDR access pattern, beat alignment, burst policy, address mapping, board protocol, or runtime/deployment interface.
expected_evidence: A code_generation artifact manifest listing generated hardware files, hashes, generator/tool versions, command line, and source SACG state path.

Provenance links from generated modules back to artifact.stage2.template_selection, artifact.stage3.pipeline_plan, artifact.stage4.parameter_binding, model operators, pipeline nodes, and selected templates.
An updated SACG state adding generated-code artifacts and edges without removing prior checker evidence or active constraints.
A report confirming the generator did not delete tests, alter golden outputs, loosen tolerances, bypass checkers, or change model semantics.
Evidence that generated self-attention preserves the model's GQA/KV-head semantics and does not reinterpret it as MHA.
Evidence that numeric behavior follows constraint.numeric.policy, including accumulation and rounding choices used in generated hardware.

Evidence that stream order, residual skip paths, MLP branch join behavior, buffering, flow control, beat alignment, and memory schedule match artifact.stage3.pipeline_plan and artifact.stage4.parameter_binding.
Evidence that AXI/DDR widths, bursts, address mapping, board/runtime protocols, and deployment assumptions match target-board and tool-protocol constraints.
Post-generation checker requirements recorded for elaboration/compile/lint/interface checks and any numeric/model-equivalence checks before claiming design pass.
decision.reason: SACG memory truth reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry/backtrack requests. The prerequisite checker invariants for pipeline planning, parameter binding, and resource estimation are passing, satisfying the no-checker-pass/no-design-pass gate for entering deterministic code generation. The requested tool generates candidate hardware code from already selected templates and parameters and does not request deletion of tests, golden-output modification, tolerance loosening, checker bypass, or model semantic change. It is safe to run as a candidate artifact generator, provided any architectural deviation is recorded for human approval and later checker evidence is required before design pass.
risks: Generated code could drift from model_order edges or pipeline stream edges, especially residual skip and MLP branch ordering.
Generated self-attention could accidentally treat GQA as MHA or mis-map KV heads.
Template instantiation could silently change pipeline stages, tile sizes, parallelism, memory layout, data packing, or AXI/DDR behavior without approval.
Numeric policy drift could occur through unapproved datatype, rounding, saturation, approximation, or accumulation choices.
Memory schedule, buffering, flow control, or beat alignment mismatches could introduce deadlock, data corruption, or bandwidth violations.
Generated code may exceed resource or bandwidth estimates despite prior static checks.
Tool/backend incompatibility with Chisel, board profile, or runtime protocol may only appear at elaboration or compile time.
Any later attempt to pass by modifying tests, golden outputs, tolerances, or model semantics is forbidden and must be blocked.
